literature_notes: PAQR9 (mPRε) has an unusual topology in which BOTH the N-terminus (residues 1–84) and the C-terminus (residues 369–377) are intracellular, per the authoritative computed landmarks. The four extracellular loops (ECL1 107–118, ECL2 173–206, ECL3 260–280, ECL4 330–347) are the only surface-exposed regions, but no ledger line reports a tag insertion in any of these loops for PAQR9 or a close ortholog. L1–L5 (PMC7660923) describe 'mPR' GFP/HA constructs without specifying the isoform; L2 reports a C-terminal GFP as surface-accessible, but the computed topology places the PAQR9 C-terminus firmly intracellular (369–377), and the close-ortholog data from L6/L7 (mPRβ, PAQR8) independently confirm that both termini of the mPR family are intracellular. L8 covers mPRα and mPRβ C-terminal GFP fusions in MDA231 cells — again not mPRε and no loop residue named. Because no ledger line grounds a tolerated insertion at an extracellular position of PAQR9 or a close ortholog, zero sites qualify.

literature_other_positions.note: N-terminal GFP-mPR showed no surface staining under nonpermeabilized conditions, confirming the N-terminus is intracellular; consistent with computed topology placing residues 1–84 intracellularly.

For the close ortholog mPRβ (PAQR8), C-terminal epitope tags were detected only under permeabilized conditions, indicating the C-terminus is intracellular; the computed topology for PAQR9 likewise places residues 369–377 intracellularly, overriding the apparent surface signal reported in L2 for an unspecified mPR isoform.
